metadata.title: MU Stock Gains, but the 50-Day Moving Average Is a Mystery<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Micron Stock Is Rising. Why It’s Not What It Seems.
Micron Technology was looking to end the week on a high note, but the move does little to offer investors guidance on where shares might go next.
